_schema_note: Governance ThresholdEvaluator schema (services/control-plane/governance/evolution_decision.py ThresholdSnapshot). This file is live config only: edit it (or point EVOCHAIN_THRESHOLD_SWEEP_CONFIG_PATH at an override) to retune values, no image rebuild required.

_field_notes.enabled: Threshold is skipped entirely (fail-closed) when false. Use this to gate a metric off until its threshold_value/baseline is governance-approved.
_field_notes.telemetry_event_type: Must be one of the services/telemetry/telemetry_event.schema.json event_type enum values; the worker admits a schema-valid derived event of this type through telemetry ingest before citing it in an incident.
_field_notes.ratio_baseline_key: Optional. When set, the observed summary_field value is treated as a raw metric that must be divided by a per-artifact baseline (services/evolution/config/threshold_sweep_baselines.json, keyed by artifact_id -> {ratio_baseline_key: value}) before comparison, so threshold_value is compared against a unit-consistent multiple. When null, summary_field is compared directly (an absolute threshold).

thresholds.policy_source: EVOLUTION_REVIEW_AND_THRESHOLDS.md section 7.1 (drawdown-derived policy; absolute PnL floor is an operator-tunable placeholder pending capital-scale calibration)
